audit.why: 53.65% over 863 games with a ranged-vs-melee poke pattern; difficulty text reads HARD 8/10, which understates it, but the packet levelChart gives Brand all seven rows and the prose agrees, so the lane is Brand-favoured early and mid, with Sylas's threat being a single connected Abscond into Kingslayer sustain.
audit.corrected: Kept the difficulty rating; corrected the level chart's full layer, which said Sylas on all seven rows while the content layer and every why said Brand.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and wants.foe[0] attribute Sylas's level 6 to 'Hextech Flashtraption', a rune, not his ultimate.
audit.why: Sylas's R is Hijack, 80/55/30 seconds. That is the level-6 spike, and its 80s rank-1 cooldown is the concrete number a Brand player can play around.
audit.corrected: Named Hijack and its 80s rank-1 cooldown; kept the correct observation that Pyroclasm is a poor steal target for him.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Q his dash/engage tool, and credits his healing to Petricite Burst.
audit.why: Chain Lash (Q) is a ranged 775-unit slow zone with no dash. His gap-closers are Abscond (E, 400 units, 13/12/11/10/9s) with a recast pull, and Kingslayer (W, 400 units, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s), which is also the ability that heals him. Petricite Burst is a passive attack-damage charge and heals nothing. Brand's own Q only stuns an ablaze target, so E-then-Q remains the package.
audit.corrected: Abscond (E) named as the gap-closer with real cooldowns; Kingslayer (W) named as the heal and tied to anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The one field that exists to carry cooldowns held only template prose.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Abscond 13s/9s, Kingslayer 12s, Brand Q 8s and R 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sustain counterplay was credited to a passive rather than to Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: Kingslayer heals him off champions on a 12s rank-1 cooldown; extended trades hinge on whether anti-heal is up.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] now points at early anti-heal against Kingslayer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Title promised wave/ward discipline and W-greed; bodies explained the trade combo.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles using Abscond's range and cooldown.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E-Q stun package like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond (E) is his only real gap-closer: 13s at rank 1, 9s maxed — step up the second he burns it. - Kingslayer (W) heals him off you every 12s early. - Your Q is 8s and your R is 100s, so R buys kills only.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Sylas wins by connecting Abscond, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, and then turning your own Pyroclasm on you.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Abscond covers 400 units and recasts into a pull, so hold the wave mid-lane with flanks warded and he must cross your Pillar to reach you.

edits.before: Sylas spends Abscond / Abduct early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces 5 times and slows ablaze targets — fire it as he lands, not to open.

edits.before: That is Sylas’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: E is 13s at rank 1 — spend it on poke and Abscond is free.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: W is 10s at rank 1 and Abscond only 13s — a third pillar with Q unbanked hands him a free 400-unit dash onto a clean health bar.

edits.before: If Sylas gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Abscond / Abduct extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with W-E clears and stay relevant through stun-burn peel.
edits.after: If Sylas gets a kill, Kingslayer heals more off you and the dive is real — respect Abscond's 13s and farm it back. Two kills: clear with W-E from max range and stay relevant as stun-burn peel.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry by spacing: Sylas must spend Abscond to reach you, so stand where that 400-unit dash lands him inside a Pillar and a 5-bounce R.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Abscond (E): a 400-unit dash that recasts into a pull, 13s at rank 1 and 9s at rank 5. Step up in that window, never into it.

edits.before: Sylas has no ranged tool to trade with your Pillar of Flame, so every time he steps up to farm you can stun and burn him for free before he closes the gap with Q.
edits.after: Sylas has no ranged tool to trade with your Pillar of Flame, so every time he steps up to farm you can stun and burn him for free before Abscond (E) closes the gap.

edits.before: Hextech Flashtraption only matters if he's stolen a strong ultimate off you or an ally, and Brand's Pyroclasm isn't a game-changing steal target for him, so his level-6 spike is weaker into you than into most other mids.
edits.after: Hijack only matters if he steals a strong ultimate off you or an ally, and Brand's Pyroclasm isn't a game-changing steal target, so his level-6 spike is weaker into you than into most other mids — and Hijack is 80s at rank 1.

edits.before: Liandry's on your side punishes his melee engage hard, adding sustained burn that outlasts his sustain from Petricite Burst's healing.
edits.after: Liandry's punishes his melee engage hard, and early anti-heal cuts the Kingslayer (W) healing that otherwise wins him the extended trades.

edits.before: Brand keeps punishing his only engage tool (Q dash) with a faster stun.
edits.after: Brand punishes his only real gap-closer, Abscond (E), with a faster stun.

edits.before: Hold Pillar for his Q dash-in engage to shut down his all-in
edits.after: Hold Pillar for his Abscond dash-in to shut down the all-in

edits.before: Farm safely under tower until level 6 unlocks Hextech Flashtraption
edits.after: Farm safely under tower until level 6 unlocks Hijack, his ult steal

edits.before: Chain Q dashes and E stun to close the gap and all-in you
edits.after: Use Abscond and its recast to close the gap and all-in you

edits.before: Sylas is entirely melee-reliant with no way to answer your ranged poke, so from level 1 you can zone him off CS with Pillar of Flame and stack free damage every time he tries to farm. His only engage tool is Q, which is short-range and telegraphed, so holding your stun for the dash lets you punish any approach attempt hard. This is one of the most one-sided early lanes you'll play — abuse it and push him under tower.
edits.after: Sylas is entirely melee-reliant with no way to answer your ranged poke, so from level 1 you can zone him off CS with Pillar of Flame and stack free damage every time he tries to farm. His gap-closer is Abscond (E), 400 units and 13s at rank 1, so holding your stun for that dash lets you punish any approach attempt hard. This is one of the most one-sided early lanes you'll play — abuse it and push him under tower.

notes: Full-layer phases[N].side read 'Sylas' on all seven rows while content win[N] read 'Brand' on all seven and every phases[N].why described Brand winning that stage — a cross-layer disagreement on the entire chart. Fixed by moving side to Brand, which matches packet.levelChart (Brand x7), the content layer and the existing whys; no win[N] edit was possible because win[N] was already correct on every row. Petricite Burst does not heal (it is a stored attack charge); the healing is Kingslayer (W). Chain Lash (Q) is not a dash. 'Abscond / Abduct' is the site's name for E plus its recast and was left in place where it appears as the tracked-ability label.
